title: Elac Debut 3.0 B6.3 Bookshelf Speakers (Black) $449 Delivered @ Addicted to Audio
body:
Deal: Elac Debut 3.0 B6.3 Bookshelf Speakers (Black) $449 Delivered @ Addicted to Audio

[tonyjzx] https://addictedtoaudio.com.au/products/elac-debut-reference…
i'd like a set of these but that price is insane
these are like sub €500 in the EU but yeah…. au tax
[Adafstrike] i got the Elac DBR62 when in Europe, think final price was 660 minus tax as they had a discount, but did not have any peace of mind as check-in luggage.
[el_cheapo] Damn, just bought for $499. Good speakers, good deal.
[dottjt] What recommended amp for these? I have a dx3pro+, not sure if that's relevant tech for these.
[djmm] Get one of those basic Yamaha integrated amp you're golden
[dottjt] Sorry, what's a product example of this? I'm not too familiar with it all.
[Becoming Uncanny] I personally have 3030i Q acoustic hooked up to aiyima a07 max and its great, but if you want a good amp go on aliexpress and look at douk audio a5
[djmm] https://www.selby.com.au/brands/yamaha/yamaha-a-s301-2-chann…
[shizzle] These are pretty neat and you could keep your topping inline
https://addictedtoaudio.com.au/products/fiio-jade-audio-leve…
You can pick them up from Ali for a lot less as well
[tonyjzx] 87db means this will run on anything
cheapest but 'well known' would be a ZA3 or a Aiyima A07 if you small class d
[dottjt] Also, would you need to pair a sub with these?
[Morien] Frequency response of 42 to 38 kHz
You’d want a sub if you are gaming or watching movies. You’d appreciate it with music, but up to you.
If you did get a sub though you’d need to get an amp that supports it.
[diamondd] I'm sure they'd sound great without one, but the answer is yes.
[lazywombat] What’s a recommended sub for these speakers and what amplifier would they need?

[Melbfrog] I was comparing Elac and wharfedale diamond 12.1 to set up with fosi za3 and ZD3 in my small study room. There are some mixed reviews about this Elac. I ended up choosing wharfedale https://www.wharfedale.com.au/products/diamond-12-1-bookshel…
[badjazy] Heard them in the store, and they are exactly the same as db53, just bit bigger. I am assuming they can get louder though.
[GoodUsername] Nice deal! I visited my local Addicted to Audio shop the other month, lots of cool stuff on display. Ended up with Q Acoustics 3010c's myself, also on special currently for $299. I'm happy with them, but was restricted to very particular speaker sizes - ELAC would have been a strong contender otherwise!
[Tsapena] I also have the 3010's , for the size, price and sound theyre excellent
[SevenSmurfs] I’ve got a 3.1 paradigm setup at the moment (paradigm floor standers + centre + sub)
Is it ok to get these as my surround sounds or best to stick with paradigm (se atom) bookshelves
[JPerez] Erin's review
https://youtu.be/8kmjrC84vRg?si=t88nvUIlB55NPOMO
Pretty good price for these speakers I reckon!
Tempting
[whyisave] Minus the tracker …
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8kmjrC84vRg
[nov1911] I would personally prefer the kef for detail and sound stage, especially if you're going to be close to the speakers
but the sale makes them over double the price, hard to justify unless you can wait for a kef sale
[Budju] must… not.. buy… any… more… speakers…. 😭
[revheadgl] If it helps, I have been down that road in the past. Be happy with what you have and do not buy:) Unless you really don't like your current speakers…….lol.
[Budju] lol yeah. We're probably in the same boat. I have two pairs of ELACs and they are pretty god tier. Extremely happy with the Wharfedale Evo 4.2s.
I like the look of these bad boys though haha. Must resist.
[revheadgl] I currently have speakers that on paper, most would consider a level or two down from what I had. But they make me smile every time I watch a movie or listen to music, so absolutely no reason to change them:)
[Budju] @revheadgl: I'm literally running some creative pebble v3s as we speak 😂
Sometimes the simple things in life a good as well
[Some Random Guy] I have a topping D10 balanced, schitt Jotunheim, and KRK ROKIT powered 5 (don't asked why I have powered speakers with a DAC and amp).
If I were to bite the bullet on a good passive of passive speakers (mainly for music) how high up on the ranks is this deal (say from 1-10)?
